reason_definitions.EXPLICIT_EMPLOYMENT_APPLICATION_DOCUMENT: The complete literal requests an employment application document, sample, format, wording or role-related CV/resume guidance. Proposed only as that full exact original phrase; no generic role, resume, application or customer-service token is proposed.
reason_definitions.RESUME_VENDOR_SUPPORT_OR_ROLE_UNRESOLVED: The full original can describe customer support for a resume/CV provider or an ambiguous vendor/document route. Provider identity and intended role request are unverified; preserve without repair.
reason_definitions.PROVIDER_SERVICE_CONTINUATION_OR_ROLE_UN: The provider-like service wording does not explicitly resolve a role document versus resuming service. No provider identity or semantic equivalence is asserted.
reason_definitions.LANGUAGE_MEANING_NOT_VERIFIED: The complete source includes wording whose language meaning has not been verified for this English research review. Preserve unchanged and hold.
reason_definitions.REPEATED_DOCUMENT_WORDING_UNRESOLVED: The source repeats document wording. Do not remove the repetition or invent a corrected phrase.
reason_definitions.ACADEMIC_EXERCISE_CLASSIFICATION_UNRESOL: The literal explicitly includes a school-class exercise context. Do not allocate it to the employment pool without a separate classification review.
